components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 8px; text-align: left; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(26 26 26 / .2); border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; font: 500 17px Urbanist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1A1A1A; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-choice small { grid-column: 2; font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; color: #5F5A68; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: rgb(26 26 26 / .4); } .ds-choice.is-on { border-color: rgb(26 26 26 / .8); background: rgb(254 241 108 / .2); } .ds-dot { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: 3px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(26 26 26 / .25); } .ds-choice.is-on .ds-dot { border-color: #1A1A1A; background: #1A1A1A; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3.5px #fffae2; }

narrative.overview:
Huddle looks like the noticeboard in a church hall or community centre: sticky notes pinned at slight angles, hand-drawn doodles, a strip of bright yellow tape, and a programme you can read at a glance. It is warm, handmade and welcoming, built for organisers who are not technical and attendees who arrive on a phone from a WhatsApp link.

The marketing page is the loudest expression of the board: full-bleed coloured panels (purple, black, coral), tilted sticky notes, line illustrations, and big Instrument Serif headlines. The app (dashboard, event editor, host live, attendee pages) is the same world at rest: white paper, soft pill controls, yellow for the one thing to do, black used sparingly for what is selected or live. Expression lives in details there, not in volume.

Everything is soft and friendly. Corners are generous, outlines are gentle, and nothing is sharp or clinical.
keyCharacteristics: White paper ground with yellow as the single action colour and black as the anchor.
Instrument Serif for headlines, Urbanist for everything you read or press.
Pill buttons, big rounded cards and fields with clear but gentle outlines.
Hand-drawn line illustrations and doodles instead of icons in boxes.
Flat surfaces; depth only on things that truly float.

rules.name: The One Yellow Job Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks the thing to do or the thing that is yours. If more than one or two yellow fills compete on an app screen, demote the extras to white or mist.

rules.name: The Black Is Punctuation Rule
rules.body: In the app, black appears in small, deliberate places: text, the selected tab, Live and Added badges, the radio dot, one dark feature card. It never becomes a page background or a border on everything.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks Once Rule
rules.body: Each block has one serif headline. Body, labels and buttons are always Urbanist.

rules.name: The Pinned, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Things on the board sit flat on it. Only things you can move or dismiss get a shadow.

dos: Do keep yellow for the main action and for "yours / selected" highlights.
Do use Instrument Serif for headlines only and Urbanist for everything else.
Do give fields a visible outline (1.5px at 25% ink) so they read as inputs at a glance.
Do mark selected cards and choices with the faint yellow tint and ink outline together.
Do use hand-drawn line illustrations from public/landing/ for decoration.
donts: Don't use purple, lilac or sky as accents in the app; they belong to the marketing page.
Don't add shadows, gradients or glass blur to resting surfaces.
Don't make black heavy in the app: no black page backgrounds or thick black borders everywhere.
Don't use tracked uppercase labels or emoji in coloured squares as icons.
Don't invent customers, testimonials or statistics in any visual.
